e: Borrowed from a Turkic source. Cognates include Turkish kışlık, (colloquial) kışlak, kışla (“barracks”), Azerbaijani qışlaq, Uyghur قىشلاق (qishlaq), Karakhanid قِشْلاغْ (qıšlaɣ), Old Turkic 𐰴𐰃𐰽𐰞𐰍 (k¹is¹l¹g¹) and Yakut кыстык (kïstïk).

q: All beings support the yin and embrace the yang; And through the blending of qis they create harmony.
